text: AIMS Institutes offers PhD programs in Management and Commerce, affiliated with the University of Mysore (UoM). As a recognized research centre, AIMS provides a structured doctoral journey with expert faculty guides, end-to-end research support, and access to premium resources. The program includes one semester of coursework (20 weeks) covering Research Methodology and Review of Literature. Candidates are required to publish two research papers and submit their thesis after a minimum of 30 months.
heading: PhD Doctoral Programs in Management and Commerce

text: The School of Arts & Humanities at AIMS Institutes offers the Bachelor of Arts (BA) program with several specializations including Journalism, Psychology, Optional English, Sociology, and Economics. This 3-year undergraduate program is designed to develop critical thinking, communication skills, and a deep understanding of social dynamics. It is an ideal path for students interested in careers in media, counseling, social work, and public relations.
heading: Bachelor of Arts (BA) - Journalism, Psychology, Sociology

text: The School of Science at AIMS Institutes offers the Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) program with specializations in Microbiology, Genetics, Biochemistry, Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science. This 3-year program provides a strong foundation in scientific principles and practical laboratory skills. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in healthcare, research, and data science.
heading: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) - Microbiology, Genetics, Biochemistry

text: The Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) at AIMS is an industry-aligned program focused on developing practical management skills and corporate readiness. Unlike the MBA, the PGDM is often more dynamic and updated according to industry trends. It covers strategy, operations, finance, and marketing, preparing students for high-level corporate roles.
heading: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)

text: AIMS Institutes offers the Master of Social Work (MSW) for students committed to social change and community development. The program includes extensive field work, providing hands-on experience in various social sectors. It prepares graduates for roles in NGO management, social counseling, and human resources within the social sector.
heading: Master of Social Work (MSW)
